subject: Activation Orchestra: 90-Day Roles, Calendar & Checkpoints
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@northbridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Activation Orchestra: 90-Day Roles, Calendar & Checkpoints

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I put together a compact 90-day "Activation Orchestra" that maps milestones, clear owners, and acceptance gates so we can accelerate go-live while keeping procurement and security on the critical path. The workbook attached contains:

- Sprint calendar (weeks 0–12) with milestone dates
- Task-level owners (Redwood & NorthBridge) and escalation contacts
- Acceptance criteria for each cutover window
- Procurement and SOW checkpoints (week 4–6)

Please review the proposed kickoff date (Tue, Jun 24) and the initial integration window (Jul 7–11). If those align with your internal calendars we’ll lock them and send calendar invites. A few asks from our side to finalize:

1) Confirm the primary technical contact for API keys and test data (we recommended Sam Ellis).
2) Confirm procurement leads for SOW/invoice routing (we have procurement@northbridge.com).
3) Flag any blackout dates in July/August.

Attachment: northbridge-activation-orchestra-90d.xlsx (workbook — active tabs: milestones, owners, risk)

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@northbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation Orchestra: 90-Day Roles, Calendar & Checkpoints

Rachel / team — quick internal sync and proposed owner assignments before we finalize with NorthBridge:

- Monica: kickoff facilitator + post-kickoff adoption checkpoints (weeks 0, 2, 6, 10)
- Ben: integration owner (API onboarding, test harness, logs) — lead for Jul 7–11 integration window
- Soojin: security/compliance owner — intake for questionnaire, SOC2 artifact handoff, and audit log setup
- Rachel: executive sponsor & procurement escalation

Notes / risks to call out: procurement needs SOW by Week 4 for invoicing cadence; if SOW sign-off slips beyond Week 6 it pushes the payment milestone and we should compress week 8 acceptance window.

I’ll draft a short owner matrix and push a revised workbook to the shared Drive by EOD.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Elena Park <elena.park@northbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@northbridge.com>, procurement@northbridge.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation Orchestra: 90-Day Roles, Calendar & Checkpoints

Hi Rachel —

Thanks — this looks thorough and in the right cadence. A few items from my side:

- Sam is confirmed as the technical contact. He’ll own test data and environment provisioning.
- Procurement needs a clean SOW PDF + billing contact to start internal approval. Can you send SOW_Draft_v0.9.pdf and confirm billing name/PO terms?
- We need the security questionnaire completed during Week 2 so our internal InfoSec can review before integrations. Can Soojin own this and we'll share the questionnaire link?
- One potential conflict: our operations team has a scheduled outage Jul 9 (maintenance). Can we shift the integration window to Jul 8 and Jul 10–11 (split) or alternatively Jul 14–16?

On the calendar we’ll prioritize Jul 8 and Jul 10–11 if Redwood is okay with a split window. Also please include the acceptance gate checklist for week 10 (performance baseline + 24-hour smoke tests).

Attachment: (I will route SOW request to procurement and loop them in)

Best regards,
Elena Park
VP, Product Operations\NorthBridge Logistics
elena.park@northbridge.com | +1 617-555-0487

- Integration window: Split — Jul 8 (API sandbox smoke + partial runs) and Jul 10–11 (full integration). Owner: Ben
- Security questionnaire: Soojin to start intake Mon, Jun 16; completion target Fri, Jun 20 (Week 2). Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/NorthBridge/Security-Questionnaire
- SOW: SOW_Draft_v0.9.pdf attached — Procurement requested clean PDF and billing contact. Billing: NorthBridge Logistics, Attn: Accounts Payable, ap@northbridge.com. Net 30 terms noted in draft. Owner: Rachel to coordinate sign-off and DocuSign routing.
- Acceptance gates (Week 10): Performance baseline + 24-hour smoke tests — documented in workbook tab "acceptance".

Attachments: SOW_Draft_v0.9.pdf; northbridge-activation-orchestra-90d.xlsx (updated)

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.
